The '''Arranda family''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] family from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. In the early stages of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it consisted of [[Kalf Arranda]], his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] [[Milessa Arranda|Milessa]] and their [[Youngling/Legends|children]] [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash]] and [[Zak Arranda/Legends|Zak]]. They were also related to a woman named [[Beryl (Human female)|Beryl]], who had married the [[Shi'ido]] [[Moloch Hoole]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Tash and Zak Arranda were orphaned when their parents [[Death/Legends|died]] in the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction of Alderaan]], and were placed in the custody of their "uncle" [[Mammon Hoole]], the brother of Moloch.<ref name="dspl" />
